env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd wbig
! logos build ./...
stderr 'comptime::node_limit'
cd ..

cd wbig
logos build -gcflags=all=-logos.comptime_nodes=1000000 ./...
logos run -gcflags=all=-logos.comptime_nodes=1000000 ./...
stdout '^big-ok$'
cd ..

cd wsmall
! logos build -gcflags=all=-logos.comptime_nodes=4 ./...
stderr 'comptime::node_limit'
stderr 'expansion has 24 nodes above the selected limit 4'
logos build -gcflags=all=-logos.comptime_nodes=24 ./...
! logos build -gcflags=all=-logos.comptime_nodes=23 ./...
stderr 'comptime::node_limit'
logos build ./...
logos run ./...
stdout '^small-ok$'
cd ..
cd wmed
! logos build ./...
stderr 'comptime::node_limit'
stderr 'expansion has 4100 nodes above the selected limit 4096'
! logos build -gcflags=all=-logos.comptime_nodes=4099 ./...
stderr 'expansion has 4100 nodes above the selected limit 4099'
logos build -gcflags=all=-logos.comptime_nodes=4100 ./...
logos run -gcflags=all=-logos.comptime_nodes=4100 ./...
stdout '^med-ok$'
cd ..

mkdir wtoml
cp wbig/go.mod wtoml/go.mod
cp wbig/big.lgo wtoml/big.lgo
cd wtoml
! logos build ./...
stderr 'comptime::node_limit'
cp ../toml-raised.toml logos.toml
logos run ./...
stdout '^big-ok$'
cd ..

cd wsmall
cp ../toml-limit-23.toml logos.toml
! logos build ./...
stderr 'expansion has 24 nodes above the selected limit 23'
cp ../toml-limit-24.toml logos.toml
logos build ./...
rm logos.toml
cd ..

-- wbig/go.mod --
module example.com/bignest

go 1.27

-- wbig/big.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

type Wide struct {
	A0 int
	A1 int
	A2 int
	A3 int
	A4 int
	A5 int
	A6 int
	A7 int
	A8 int
	A9 int
	B0 int
	B1 int
	B2 int
	B3 int
	B4 int
	B5 int
}

func show(v Wide) int {
	n := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[Wide]() {
		const for _, g := range comptime.Fields[Wide]() {
			const for _, h := range comptime.Fields[Wide]() {
				n += v.[f] + v.[g] + v.[h]
			}
		}
	}
	return n
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("big-ok")
}

-- wsmall/go.mod --
module example.com/smallnest

go 1.27

-- wsmall/small.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

type Small struct {
	X int
	Y int
}

func show(v Small) int {
	n := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[Small]() {
		n += v.[f]
	}
	return n
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("show:", show(Small{X: 1, Y: 2}))
	fmt.Println("small-ok")
}

-- toml-raised.toml --
[lints.thresholds]
max_comptime_ast_nodes = 1000000

-- toml-limit-23.toml --
[lints.thresholds]
max_comptime_ast_nodes = 23

-- toml-limit-24.toml --
[lints.thresholds]
max_comptime_ast_nodes = 24

-- wmed/go.mod --
module example.com/mednest

go 1.27

-- wmed/med.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

type Big struct {
	F0 int
	F1 int
	F2 int
	F3 int
	F4 int
	F5 int
	F6 int
	F7 int
	F8 int
	F9 int
	F10 int
	F11 int
	F12 int
	F13 int
	F14 int
	F15 int
	F16 int
	F17 int
	F18 int
	F19 int
	F20 int
	F21 int
	F22 int
	F23 int
	F24 int
	F25 int
	F26 int
	F27 int
	F28 int
	F29 int
	F30 int
	F31 int
	F32 int
	F33 int
	F34 int
	F35 int
	F36 int
	F37 int
	F38 int
	F39 int
	F40 int
	F41 int
	F42 int
	F43 int
	F44 int
	F45 int
	F46 int
	F47 int
	F48 int
	F49 int
}

type Small struct {
	G0 int
	G1 int
	G2 int
	G3 int
}

func show(v Big, w Small) int {
	n := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[Big]() {
		const for _, g := range comptime.Fields[Small]() {
			n += v.[f] + w.[g]
		}
	}
	return n
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("med-ok")
}
